audience: The owner and prospective clients judging what this code-driven studio can produce
promise: A 15-second motion designer showreel: identity, easing, morphing, systems, depth and kinetic type, one idea per bar, all written in code
direction: Reference-grammar recreation (references/user-ref): HUD index + 128 BPM bar counter, coral/cream/blue/ink/lime flat fields, Archivo variable heavy extended + Instrument Serif Italic + Space Mono, spring morphs, Truchet waves, 3D point clouds, 1/8-note type cuts, original score

sound.note: Synthesised in showreel2/score.mjs (lib/audio.mjs + lib/sfx.mjs); no samples, no licence needed

creative.viewer: someone scrolling a feed who should recognise a serious motion designer in two seconds
creative.problem: most showreels list skills; this one has to demonstrate them with taste
creative.promise: every capability proven on screen in the bar it belongs to
creative.evidence: the reel is made of the techniques it names: easing curves, springs, Truchet systems, perspective point clouds, kinetic type
creative.emotion: confident, playful precision with one hard drop
creative.motif: a coral dot that becomes burst, disc, full stop and flood
creative.light: flat saturated fields, one chromatic fringe on the iris, no photographic light
creative.camera: no camera: composition transforms, perspective of the point clouds
creative.motion: springs with overshoot, literal easing demonstration, directional smear, ripple waves, constant-speed rotation, 1/8-note cuts
creative.sound: original 128 BPM bed; hits on the iris, the drop, every type card and the bloom; a linear sine sweep for LINEAR.
creative.pacing: slow hook, bar-per-idea middle, one drop at 7.5 s, breakdown for depth, rapid type, held lock-up
creative.payoff: the dot floods the frame and returns as the burst beside the wordmark

shots.purpose: hook: ring, dot, burst glyph, collapse
wordmark with variable-width letters and the italic subtitle
six dots race A to B with six named easings
circle to triangle to star to square with echoes

570-vertex mesh to sphere to torus in perspective
EASE IN OUT NEVER LINEAR at 1/8-note cuts, the full stop floods
burst glyph, confetti, wordmark lock-up, credit line
